pages.body_text: Northwind Tooling Northwind Tooling is a precision tooling manufacturer that supplies machined components to aerospace and motorsport suppliers across the United Kingdom. Northwind Tooling was founded in 1998 and operates from Manchester. What does Northwind Tooling make? Northwind Tooling makes precision jigs, fixtures and machined components to tolerances of five microns. Northwind Tooling serves aerospace, motorsport and medical device manufacturers. How do I place an order with Northwind? Northwind Tooling accepts orders by email with a drawing attached. Northwind Tooling returns a quote within two working days. Contact us to get a quote. Where is Northwind Tooling based? Northwind Tooling is based in Manchester, United Kingdom, and ships across Europe. Northwind Tooling holds AS9100 certification for aerospace work.

pages.body_text: About Northwind Tooling Northwind Tooling has manufactured precision components in Manchester since 1998. Northwind Tooling employs forty machinists and holds AS9100 certification. What is the history of Northwind Tooling? Northwind Tooling began as a two-person workshop in 1998 and now operates twelve CNC centres. Northwind Tooling has supplied aerospace tier-one manufacturers since 2004. Which certifications does Northwind hold? Northwind Tooling holds AS9100 Revision D and ISO 9001 certification. Northwind Tooling is audited annually by an accredited body. Learn more or contact us.
